identity.only_variable: replace passive first extreme touch fill with first-retest close-back-inside Bollinger(20,2.5) confirmation and next-bar activation
identity.first_retest_policy: inspect offsets 1..=12; short first high>=source high, long first low<=source low; first touch is terminal and an untouched pending setup is replaced by a newer source setup
identity.close_confirmation_policy: short confirms when completed retest close<=current upper band; long confirms when close>=current lower band; the retest close is included in the 20-close band
identity.activation_policy: confirmation signal exists only at retest close; earliest entry timestamp is the next 15m candle and this L1 report does not read its price
identity.label_boundary: reads source setup and completed pre-entry retest candles only; no entry price, stop/target path, MFE, MAE, exit, PnL, R, win, or loss fields

coverage.universe_limitation: current-live Top60 is a partial diagnostic with survivorship bias; it is not a point-in-time historical universe or OOS proof

decision.reason: 至少一项预注册 L1 门禁失败；不得读取确认后的盈亏或进入 L2。
